configuration.rationale: V5 full/freeze10 at LR .001 regressed. Compare its conservative head recipe with broader neck/head adaptation at LR .0001 on all v6 data. No interpolation or test-driven grid expansion.
configuration.selection: Maximum validation ONNX pipeline F1; ties: higher recall, lower threshold, recipe order, best before last. Baselines optimize on the identical threshold grid. Replicas retain the first seed threshold and checkpoint rule; deliver seed 42, never select a seed using its score.

limitations: No independent-day validation for new PhenoZero/TS02 cameras

pretraining_code_revision.reason: Serialize numeric parity evidence as Python float and validate before delivery copies
